severity_basis: SOP-MNT-022 Clause 4.1 — cladding damage over 20% of the insulated section (35% recorded); the remaining-life rule in SOP-INS-014 Clause 4.5 does NOT apply, since life exceeds 4 years
traps: Remaining life is above 4 years, so citing SOP-INS-014 Clause 4.5 as the basis for Medium severity is incorrect.
The governing location is the worst remaining life, not the thinnest absolute reading.
Inlet nozzle N1 has a higher corrosion rate but more margin, so it is not governing.
